newsitem.title: CANADA: West Prairie may see widespread, light frost Sep 4.
newsitem.headline: West Prairie may see widespread, light frost Sep 4.

text.p: Canada's western Prairie region was forecast to see a slight to moderate risk of frost from next Wednesday onward, Environment Canada said.

There was no risk of frost forecast anywhere on the Prairies Friday and Saturday mornings but a slight risk in Alberta's Peace River Valley Sunday morning, Environment Canada's 10-day frost outlook said.
A slight risk was forecast in the Peace region Monday morning, turning to a moderate risk there Tuesday morning.
A slight risk of frost was expected in Alberta's northern grainbelt Tuesday morning as well, Environment Canada said.

A moderate risk of frost was forecast in the Peace region Wednesday to Friday mornings while a slight risk of frost was expected across all but the extreme south of Alberta and into western Saskatchewan Wednesday to Friday mornings.
